reasoning: This checkout is primarily a deployable Kubeflow Notebooks v2 workspaces application. The root README describes interactive development environments for AI, ML, and data workloads; the controller is a Kubernetes runtime component that reconciles Workspace and WorkspaceKind custom resources and is packaged with a Deployment and CRDs; the backend provides an HTTP API/BFF for the frontend; and the frontend is a separately built web UI with its own container and deployment assets. Although the controller subproject has operator characteristics, the checkout as a whole is a multi-component running application rather than a controller-only operator, reusable library, or configuration-only repository.
